origin.description: Closest-described specification: manifest models M1-M3 (stage 1) and M4-M8 (stage 2) with the origin levels of every axis below; variables as defined in manifest.json.
origin.variable_definitions: manifest.json 'variables' with origin constructions: entrepreneurial_activity from screening items; employed-only sample (GEMWORK 1-2); ages 18-54; unweighted; survey-level variables z-scored across analytic survey-years; paid leave lagged one year; part-time common definition; new_technology = OMNEWT_5 codes 1 or 2; plan_b_motivation = OMREASON code 2 only; random intercept and female slope at both levels with unstructured covariance; adaptive quadrature.

axes.decision: Labour-force restriction for the stage 1 sample

levels.description: Employed only: GEMWORK in {1, 2} (full- or part-time)
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Footnote 2 contrasts the analytic sample with 'individuals who are not employed'; the supplement's full-sample model adds a 'not employed' control.
levels.basis: MAIN p.10 fn 2; S1 p.3 Table A3 note †

levels.description: Employed plus unemployed job-seekers (GEMWORK 1, 2 and 6 'not working: other')
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Literal reading of 'in the labor force' would include the unemployed, but GEMWORK code 6 mixes unemployed with other non-working persons and the article's footnote points to employment.
levels.basis: MAIN p.10 text vs fn 2; GEMWORK code list in sources/icpsr20320_gem_aps.md

levels.description: Full sample including not employed, with a not-employed control
levels.label: non_equivalent
levels.rationale: This is the supplement's separately reported robustness model (A3M2), not an interchangeable origin specification.

levels.description: GEMAGE 18 to 54 inclusive
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: GEM samples adults 18 and older; 'over 18' read as the survey's lower bound.
levels.basis: MAIN p.10; sources/icpsr20320_gem_aps.md (unit: adults 18 and older)

levels.description: GEMAGE 19 to 54 inclusive
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Literal reading of 'over 18'; changes a small age slice only.

levels.description: Use exactly the country-years listed in the supplement's survey-year column
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: The realized sample is documented; implementers should reproduce it where the registered file allows.

levels.description: All 2001-2008 country-years in the registered file for the 24 countries, dropping only those with no responses on required items
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: The article states only the year range; some exclusions in the realized list have no stated rule, so a rule-based reconstruction may add or lose a few surveys.

axes.decision: Treatment of 'don't know' on screening items used in the outcome

levels.description: Treat codes 8 and 9 as missing (listwise deletion)
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Standard practice; the article does not say otherwise.

levels.description: Treat 'don't know' as 'no' (GEM pre-2002 convention)
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: The harmonizer notes this convention for early years; it changes the denominator marginally.

levels.description: Screening items: BSTART = 1 and no wages paid for more than three months, OR OWNMGE = 1
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Matches the article's verbatim definitions of nascent entrepreneur and established owner.

levels.description: GEM transformed indicators: SUBOANWT = 1 or OMBABYBT = 1 or OMESTBBT = 1
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: The transforms add ownership and activity conditions not stated in the article; plausible if the author used GEM's standard variables.

levels.description: Nascent entrepreneurship only (TEA-style early stage)
levels.label: non_equivalent
levels.rationale: A distinct reported outcome (supplement Model 1), not an interchangeable specification.
levels.basis: S1 p.3 Table A3 Model 1; MAIN p.11

axes.decision: Definition of the established-owner subsample for Table 2

levels.description: All current owner-managers (OWNMGE = 1) with owner-module data
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: The article defines established owner by the screening item alone.
levels.basis: MAIN p.11; MAIN p.14 'Analyzing Gender Gaps among Established Business Owners'

levels.description: Owner-managers whose business has paid wages for more than 42 months (OMESTBBT = 1)
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: GEM's standard meaning of 'established'; would exclude new (baby) businesses and reduce the subsample.

levels.description: OMREASON = 2 ('no better choices for work') -> 1; all other substantive answers -> 0
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Matches the article's quoted response category.

levels.description: OMWHY = -1 ('best choice') -> 1
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: OMWHY is the harmonizer's recode of OMREASON; its 'best choice' category corresponds to the same response.

levels.description: OMREASON in {2, 3} (including the mixed 'work choice and opportunity' answer) -> 1
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: The article does not mention the mixed category; including it broadens the outcome.

levels.description: OMNEWT_5 in {1 'less than a year', 2 'one to five years'} -> 1; 3 -> 0
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Article wording: technologies 'less than five years old'.

levels.description: OMNEWT_5 = 1 only -> 1
levels.label: non_equivalent
levels.rationale: Contradicts the stated five-year threshold.
levels.basis: MAIN p.14-15; OMNEWT_5 codes in sources/icpsr20320_gem_aps.md

levels.description: log(years since first payment + 1)
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Parallels the +1 adjustment the article states for business size; not stated for business age.

levels.description: log(years), dropping businesses with zero completed years
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Literal reading; drops the youngest businesses.

levels.description: OECD common definition (under 30 usual hours), women part-time as percent of women's total employment
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: The cross-nationally comparable series the OECD labour force statistics present by default.

levels.description: National definitions of part-time
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Also published by the OECD; the article does not say which definition it used.

levels.description: Common definition restricted to employees (ICSE93_1)
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: The supplement note says 'female employees'; Japan lacks this series.
levels.basis: S1 p.1 Table A1 note ‡; sources/oecd_sources.md

axes.decision: Standardization and squared-term construction for survey-level variables

levels.description: z-score each survey-level variable across the analytic country-years; squared paid leave = square of the standardized variable
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Simplest reading of 'all survey-level variables are standardized'.

levels.description: z-score across the 24 country means, then merge
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Changes scale and centering only; coefficients per SD would differ.

levels.description: Standardize the raw squared paid-leave term separately
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Alternative reading; rescales the quadratic term.

levels.description: Changes lagged one year
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Stated choice.

levels.description: No lag
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Author reports very similar results.

levels.description: Two-year lag
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Author reports very similar results.

axes.decision: Childcare spending for years without a published value

levels.description: Linear interpolation between 2005 and 2007 and carry nearest value to 2001-2004 and 2008
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: The article says missing years were imputed but not how.

levels.description: Use the registered annual OECD PF3.1 series directly for every year
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Sourced fallback with a broader definition (childcare plus pre-primary) and later vintage.

levels.description: Unstructured: intercept-slope covariance estimated at each level
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Article silent; the implied parameter counts from printed log likelihood and AIC are consistent with six variance-covariance parameters (see forensic F06).

levels.description: Independent random intercept and slope at each level
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Common software default when covariance is not requested; two fewer parameters.
levels.basis: Rabe-Hesketh and Skrondal 2012 (cited MAIN p.15) describe both structures

levels.description: Unweighted
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: No weights mentioned anywhere in the article; multilevel logit software of the period had limited weight support.

levels.description: Weighted with WEIGHT_L (18-64 recentred weight)
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: GEM documentation recommends weights; the article does not use or mention them.

axes.decision: Likelihood approximation for the mixed logit

levels.description: Adaptive Gauss-Hermite quadrature (software default number of points)
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Default for the cited software approach.
levels.basis: Rabe-Hesketh and Skrondal 2012, cited MAIN p.15

levels.description: Adaptive quadrature with more integration points
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Increases accuracy without changing the estimand.

levels.description: Laplace approximation
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Can bias variance components and slopes for binary outcomes with random slopes.
levels.basis: Rabe-Hesketh and Skrondal 2012; Raudenbush and Bryk 2002 (cited MAIN p.15)

axes.decision: Social-status variable for 2001-2002 surveys (item absent in registered files)

levels.description: Impute each country's 2001-2002 survey-level status from its earliest available survey year (2003 or 2004)
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Keeps the article's sample intact; the article's own handling is unknown.

levels.description: Drop 2001-2002 surveys from all models
levels.label: non_equivalent
levels.rationale: Changes the sample substantially; year dummies for 2001-2002 disappear.

levels.description: (OMYR5JOB - OMNOWJOB) > 5
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Article: 'expected to hire more than five additional employees in the next five years'.

levels.description: OMYR5JOB > 5 (total expected jobs rather than additional)
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: A common GEM operationalization, but the article says 'additional'.

compatibility.reason: A1.2 is the supplement's full-sample robustness model for stage 1 only.
Nascent-only outcome has no established-owner stage.
Dropping 2001-2002 surveys contradicts reproducing the listed survey-years.
Mutually exclusive sources for the same variable.
Common-definition employee series absent for Japan; must fall back to A10.0 or A10.1 for that country.

notes: Explicitly listed controls (age, age squared, postsecondary, year dummies, sole owner, business age, six country-level controls) are held fixed within the equivalent set. Distinct outcomes (Models 4-8; supplement Model 1) are not interchangeable. No alternatives were added beyond those with an article or methodological basis.
